description: This file defines the Favorites class which extends Basic. It provides methods for managing user favorites, including retrieving, deleting, and saving favorite records in the SuiteCRM system. The class interacts with database objects and BeanFactory to fetch and manipulate Favorite entities.

classes.name: Favorites
classes.description: A class managing user favorites, with methods for deleting, retrieving, and saving favorites in a SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: deleteFavorite
methods.description: Deletes a favorite record by setting its 'deleted' flag to 1, given an ID.

methods.name: getFavoriteID
methods.description: Retrieves the favorite record ID for a specific module and record ID for the current user.

methods.name: getCurrentUserSidebarFavorites
methods.description: Fetches the current user's favorite items to display in the sidebar, optionally for a specific item ID.

methods.name: getCurrentUserFavoritesForModule
methods.description: Retrieves a list of favorite items for the current user filtered by module.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the save method to assign the current user ID if not set before saving.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates whether the class implements a specific interface; always returns false for 'ACL'.
